title: ExtendedAE issue #197: [Bug] Opening a provider with a networking tool in your inventory crashes
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (LGPL-3.0) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by Kevin-Marsh]
Placing a networking tool into your inventory and right clicking a pattern provider crashes to the main menu. It has to be in your inventory but not being held to do it. This behaviour isn't present without Applied Flux installed.

[Logs](https://mclo.gs/HIutbef)
Neoforge: 21.0.57
Minecraft: 1.21
Applied Energistics: 19.0.8
Applied Flux: 1.21-1.0.1

[comment by GlodBlock (owner)]
fixed in 1.0.2
